The first goodbyes

Scroll
Departures

The first goodbyes

Every mobility ends the same way it starts: suitcases by the door. This week the group finally started thinning out. One by one, people packed up, went around hugging everyone, and drove off home. It happened fast, one day someone's there at breakfast, next day their room's empty.

Leaving behind

Empty chairs at CJ

The dinner table at Casa da Juventude somehow felt bigger every night, even though it wasn't. Seats that were loud and full last week just sat there empty. You don't really notice how much someone fills a room until they're not in it anymore.

The road

Watching them drive off

Hard to watch, honestly. Especially Brandor, one of those people who just made everything better by being around. Going to miss them a lot. But it's not really goodbye, more of a "see you later." We'll cross paths again somewhere.

Home

Carrying memories

Everyone who left took a piece of Amarante with them, and honestly, we hope it meant as much to them as it did to us. Weeks like this one don't come around twice. So instead of moping about it being over, we'd rather just be glad it happened.
